hypothesis: The V12 learned pursuit movement accounts for its +0.058 kills/game signal, while its learned BOMB overrides account for the large self-kill regression; preserving every frozen-DQN bomb decision should retain some kill gain without losing survival or anti-loop behavior.
changed_factor: The two fixed V12 pursuit heads may override only learned directional actions at confidence 0.70 or 0.85. Every learned BOMB recommendation falls back to the frozen DQN action. No parameters are retrained or selected from V12 evaluation outcomes.
controls: Same frozen checkpoint, trained pursuit artifacts, empty-board context gate, broad persistent loop guard, action mask, scenarios, opponents, slots, and paired fresh seeds. Only learned BOMB override permission changes from V12.
selection: Among fresh-pilot-eligible fixed heads, choose the largest kill gain, then score gain, then the higher confidence threshold. Confirm once on fresh worlds; never promote automatically.
